[Docs](../../docs.html) / [Question types](../../docs.html#question-types)

Add a question and choose Date. The respondent picks it from a calendar.

![The a date question selected in the editor, its settings outlined.](../../../docs/question-types/date-editor.png){width=100%}

## What the respondent sees

![The question as the respondent sees it.](../../../docs/question-types/date-preview.png){width=90%}

## Settings

- **Required.** Asks for a date before the respondent goes on.

## Best practices for research

Ask for a date only when the day matters. For how long ago, a numeric question is quicker to answer.

Reference: Dillman, D. A., Smyth, J. D., & Christian, L. M. (2014). *Internet, phone, mail, and mixed-mode surveys: The tailored design method* (4th ed.). Wiley.
